On my last day at work, not only did my manager not say goodbye, our last conversation was filled with tension. I don't have any attachment to this company anymore but it still left a bad taste in my mouth.

output: I keep replaying that final exchange in my head, wondering if I should have said something different or just walked away sooner. It’s strange how something so small can linger and make me feel like I didn’t leave on my own terms.
